summary: CIMG Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into securities purchase agreements with non-U.S. investors to sell up to 43.33 billion units at $0.015 each for gross proceeds up to $650M. Each unit comprises one common share and one warrant exercisable at $0.015 for two years. Consideration may be paid in Bitcoin or USD, with a Bitcoin reference price of $65,000. An initial closing of 900M units raised ~$13.5M, with warrants fully exercised, issuing 1.8B shares total. The filing describes a capital raising transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: further tranches and Bitcoin volatility affecting pricing.
